title: Verify create/edit/delete of a fee/discount template needs Settings → Service
custom_preconds: 1. Two ZZAUTOTEST roles: Role A WITH Settings → Service; Role B WITHOUT it. Assign by exact-user-match to Tech.
custom_steps:
1. As a role WITH Settings → Service, open Administration → Service → Fees & Discounts and create/edit/delete a template.
2. As a role WITHOUT it, try to reach the page.
custom_expected:
With Settings → Service, the admin Fees & Discounts page (Administration → Service → Fees & Discounts, below Canned Lines) opens and templates can be created, edited and deleted, and the 'Pass convenience fee to customer' toggle can be changed.
Without Settings → Service, the 'Fees & Discounts' nav item is not shown and navigating directly to the admin Fees & Discounts page is blocked (it bounces away to the Work Orders page); templates cannot be created/edited/deleted. Having Settings → Finance alone does NOT grant access.
